extracted.name: Easy Authentic Mexican Rice
extracted.description: This easy Mexican rice recipe with onion powder, garlic powder, and tomato sauce makes for an easy side dish that’s ready to serve in just 25 minutes!
instruction_lines: Heat canola oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; season with onion powder and garlic powder. Stir in rice and cook until golden, 2 to 4 minutes.
Stir in water and tomato sauce; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, about 15 minutes.
